description: The image presents three side-by-side pie charts displaying the distribution of quantifiers and operations across three distinct reasoning domains: "Categorical," "Approximate Number Generation," and "Disjunctive &Conjunctive." Across all three charts, there is no separate legend; instead, bolded text labels and exact percentage values are positioned directly inside each corresponding slice, and none of the segments are visually exploded or offset. The first chart, "Categorical," contains four un-ordered slices: a light blue slice representing Universal Quantifiers (29.07%), a light pink slice for Limiter (27.91%), a light orange slice for Negation (27.91%), and a light green slice for Existential Quantifiers (15.12%). The second chart, "Approximate Number Generation," features three slices visually ordered by descending size clockwise starting from the right: a light beige slice for Approximate Quantities (45.03%), a light blue slice for Comparative Relationships (36.26%), and a light purple slice for Absolute Absence (18.71%). The third chart, "Disjunctive &Conjunctive," is divided into two nearly equal segments: a light pinkish-purple slice on the right for Conjunctive representing 50.49%, and a light greyish-blue slice on the left for Disjunctive accounting for 49.51%.
